title: N. Korea rejects S. Korean mine blast findings as blame-shifting

blocks.text: North Korea’s Foreign Ministry on Tuesday rejected South Korean military findings blaming Pyongyang for recent landmine blasts, accusing Seoul of trying to “shift the blame” for its own accident. In a statement carried by the official Korean Central News Agency, the ministry accused South Korea of seeking to hold North Korea accountable for “the premeditated farce” and tarnish Pyongyang’s international image. “It is a grave provocation never to be overlooked and a wanton violation of our sovereignty that deserves sure punishment,” the ministry said.
